# netcup_tasks (Data Source)

The tasks of the netcup SCP account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_tasks" "running" {
  state = "RUNNING"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of entries. Reads all entries if unset.
- `offset` (Number) Number of entries to skip.
- `q` (String) Search term.
- `server_id` (Number) Only tasks of this server.
- `state` (String) Only tasks in this state, `PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `FINISHED`, `ERROR`, `WAITING_FOR_CANCEL` or `CANCELED`.

### Read-Only

- `tasks` (Attributes List) Matching tasks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `executing_user` (Attributes) User who executed it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks--executing_user))
- `finished_at` (String) End time.
- `message` (String) Message of the task.
- `name` (String) Name of the task.
- `on_rollback` (Boolean) The `onRollback` value of the SCP REST API.
- `started_at` (String) Start time.
- `state` (String) State of the task.
- `task_progress` (Attributes) Progress of the task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks--task_progress))
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the task.

<a id="nestedatt--tasks--executing_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks.executing_user`

Read-Only:

- `company` (String) Company.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the user.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) User name.


<a id="nestedatt--tasks--task_progress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks.task_progress`

Read-Only:

- `expected_finished_at` (String) Expected end time.
- `progress_in_percent` (Number) Progress in percent.
